text: この　あたりは　たてものが　すくねえ　から　よく　はしりに　くるぜ！

structure.jp: たてものが　すくねえ　から
よく　はしりに　くるぜ！

patterns.name: 〜に (purpose)
patterns.explanation: A shortened verb plus に before くる tells what you come for. はしりに　くる = 'come to ride'.

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a statement gives the reason for what follows. すくねえ is a rough way to say すくない. すくねえ　から = 'because there are few'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, manly talk that pushes your statement at the listener. くるぜ = 'I come here, man!'.
